```{r, warning=F, message=F}


library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)






# 6.1. Import data


data_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/data"
raw_data_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/raw_data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"


metadata_df_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)

host_counts <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "host_gene_counts.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F, row.names=1)[, -1]

counts <- host_counts[, metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name, drop=F]

stopifnot(all(colnames(counts) == metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name))






# 6.2. Filtering + TMM normalization


group <- factor(
  metadata_df_with_folds$LRTI_adjudication,
  levels=c("No Evidence", "Definite"))

dge <- DGEList(counts=counts, group=group)

keep <- rowSums(dge$counts > 10) > 0.2 * ncol(dge$counts)
dge  <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes=F]
dge  <- calcNormFactors(dge, method="TMM")

dim(dge)






# 6.3. voom transformation


metadata_df_with_folds$sex          <- factor(metadata_df_with_folds$sex)
metadata_df_with_folds$age_in_years <- as.numeric(metadata_df_with_folds$age_in_years)

design <- model.matrix(~group + age_in_years + sex, data=metadata_df_with_folds)

v <- voom(dge, design, plot=T)

colnames(design)
dim(v$E)






# 6.4. Linear modeling with limma


fit <- lmFit(v, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

colnames(coef(fit))

de_results <- topTable(fit, coef="groupDefinite", number=Inf, sort.by="P") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene")






# 6.5. Format limma results


res_df <- de_results %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    log2FoldChange = logFC,
    padj           = adj.P.Val
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    padj           = ifelse(is.na(padj), 1, padj),
    log2FoldChange = ifelse(is.na(log2FoldChange), 0, log2FoldChange),
    negLog10P      = -log10(padj + 1e-300)
  )

res_df$gene_symbol <- ensg2gene$gene_symbol[match(res_df$gene, ensg2gene$X)]
res_df$gene_symbol[is.na(res_df$gene_symbol)] <- res_df$gene[is.na(res_df$gene_symbol)]

res_df <- res_df %>%
  mutate(
    sig = padj < 0.05,
    direction = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Definite",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "NoEvidence",
      TRUE ~ "NotSignificant"
    )
  )






# 6.6. Volcano Plot


label_data <- bind_rows(
  res_df %>% filter(direction=="Definite")    %>% arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange)), padj) %>% slice_head(n=10),
  res_df %>% filter(direction=="NoEvidence")  %>% arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange)), padj) %>% slice_head(n=10)
)

volcano_plot_gene <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=negLog10P)) +

  geom_point(aes(color=direction), alpha=0.75, size=2) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Definite"        = "#D55E00",
      "NoEvidence"      = "#8B4789",
      "NotSignificant"  = "grey85"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed",
             linewidth=0.6, color="grey40") +

  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-1, 1), linetype="dotted",
             colour="grey70", linewidth=0.4) +

  geom_text_repel(
    data        = label_data,
    aes(label   = gene_symbol),
    size        = 14 / 2.845,
    fontface    = "italic",
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding  = 0.7,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    segment.color = "grey60",
    segment.size  = 0.3
  ) +

  annotate("text",
    x=0, y=9.5,
    label  = paste0(format(sum(res_df$sig), big.mark=","), " DE genes"),
    size   = 16 / 2.845,
    family = "Arial",
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  labs(
    x       = expression(log[2]*" fold change"),
    y       = expression(-log[10](P[adj])),
    title   = "Transcriptomic differential expression",
    caption = paste0(
    "\u2190 Downregulated in LRTI",
    "        ",
    "Upregulated in LRTI \u2192"
  )
    ) +

  scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0.02, 0.15))) +

  theme_classic(base_size=16, base_family="Arial") +

  theme(
    text        = element_text(family="Arial", size=16, face="plain"),
    axis.title  = element_text(family="Arial", size=16, colour="black", face="plain"),
    axis.text   = element_text(family="Arial", size=16, colour="black", face="plain"),
    axis.line   = element_line(colour="black", linewidth=0.5),
    plot.title  = element_text(family="Arial", size=16, face="plain",
                               colour="black", hjust=0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=16, color="black", family="Arial"),
    plot.margin  = ggplot2::margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )

print(volcano_plot_gene)

write.csv(res_df, file.path(results_dir, "DE_limma_results_transcriptome.csv"), row.names=F)

ggsave(
  file.path(results_dir, "volcano_transcriptome.pdf"),
  volcano_plot_gene,
  width=6.5, height=6.5, device=cairo_pdf, bg="white")

saveRDS(
  volcano_plot_gene,
  file.path(results_dir, "volcano_transcriptome.rds"))






```
